decision: retain as a measured candidate; production performance qualification remains open
scope: One pinned V8-v7 RegExp fixture, three rotating paired rounds, and the two affected Test262 stages. This is diagnostic evidence, not Task 61 qualification.

method.lisp_mindset: The parsed Expr tree is the single static representation of a RegExp pattern. Matching now passes a continuation through that tree so ordered backtracking states are visited only when the enclosing expression rejects a candidate; literal, dot, and class repetitions use iterative positions to avoid per-character State materialization and recursion.
method.binding_time: Expr nodes, quantifier bounds, and greediness are known from RegExp construction; input positions and captures remain dynamic execution state.
method.futamura_application: Specialize traversal by existing Expr variants without generating guest-specific code, changing semantics, or adding benchmark-dependent behavior.
method.v2_basis: V2 supports data-backed local representation and execution changes, while rejecting unmeasured global mechanisms. No v2 RegExp result was treated as a transferred win; the candidate was admitted only after paired measurement.

limitations: All eight V8-v7 fixtures were screened once; only RegExp has three rounds, short of eleven for every fixture.
The source tree was dirty; this is not a production or clean-source qualification.
Median RSS improved by about 0.64 MiB, but the candidate's highest sample was 3.72 MiB above the baseline's highest sample.

The three-round RegExp-only report is complete for that fixture but marks qualification_ready=false and fixture_set_matches=false; the separate all-eight report has one round and also marks qualification_ready=false.

all_eight_screen.screen_observation: Quench scored higher on seven fixtures and lower on Navier-Stokes by 2.7%; its maximum-RSS sample was lower on all eight. This is a one-round screen only: reference scores also varied between reports, so it does not establish paired intervals or a cross-benchmark performance claim.

correctness.node_oracle: No changed failing case appeared in the affected-stage comparisons, so no new Node arbitration was required.
correctness.other_suites: No unit, Wasm, or Node compatibility suites were run; this change is confined to the shared RegExp fallback and its affected Test262 stages.
